autonomous.describe: design → implement ⇄ review (⇄ systemic review) → landable

states.name: design
states.next_step: write the design into the task, then `jkb workflow fire <uid> submit_design`

states.name: design_review
states.next_step: read the design, then `jkb workflow fire <uid> approve_design` (or `reject_design`)

states.name: implement
states.next_step: implement and commit, then `jkb workflow fire <uid> submit_work`

states.name: review
states.next_step: run a review round (`/jkb-review`), then `jkb workflow observe <uid>`

states.name: systemic_review
states.next_step: find the systemic cause and record it, then `jkb workflow fire <uid> submit_systemic --reason …` — or `systemic_redesign --reason …` if the fix changes how the operator understands the system

states.name: landable
states.next_step: land it: `jkb task land <uid>`

states.name: landed
states.next_step: nothing: the task is settled

states.name: cancelled
states.next_step: nothing: the task is settled
